blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—A 76-year-old woman was robbed of around P90,000 worth of cash and jewelry at her residence in Forbes Park, Makati, with police identifying a 25-year-old pedicab driver as the suspect. The incident was reported on Sept. 24, with the suspect allegedly stealing around P50,000 in cash and P40,000 worth of jewelry from the victim.
